test_name: Access Control - AC-6 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Research-Platform-010
Primary NIST family: Access Control (AC); evidence focus: AC-6.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: two service-account access reviews are pending approval, while interactive administrator MFA remains enforced. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
